title: EU targets Amazon, Microsoft cloud units for Big Tech “gatekeeper” rules
title_zh: 欧盟针对亚马逊、微软云部门实施大型科技“看门人”规则
summary: EU antitrust regulators said Amazon and Microsoft's cloud computing services should be designated as “gatekeepers” under landmark tech rules, ‌a step that would subject them to strict obligations aimed at curbing market ‌power.
summary_zh: 欧盟反垄断监管机构表示，根据具有里程碑意义的科技规则，亚马逊和微软的云计算服务应被指定为“看门人”，这一步骤将使它们承担旨在遏制市场力量的严格义务。
